script:
Yang Canghai
You used to be an assassin with the codename Old K, working for years to handle "dirty business" that wealthy people found inconvenient to do themselves, which gave your hands thick calluses. Later, feeling this profession had no future, you partnered with several former clients to switch to the antique business in Northeast China, making your fortune by trafficking in artifacts.
Eighteen years ago, you met Hai Bei, who wanted to sell a batch of artifacts. He told you he had some items from Changbai Mountains at a very reasonable price. You were skeptical, but after seeing his goods, you discovered they were extremely ancient and precious artifacts, so you quickly reached an agreement with him. Hai Bei told you that the condition for selling you this batch of artifacts at a low price was that you couldn't reveal to anyone that he was the seller. Although you found this puzzling, you couldn't resist the temptation of the artifacts and purchased this batch from him in several transactions.
This batch of artifacts made both you and Hai Bei a small fortune. You heard that Hai Bei used the money to start some small transportation businesses, and you lost contact. Until one day in 1930, Hai Bei suddenly approached you again, saying he had more artifacts to sell and wanted to resume cooperation. After inspecting the goods, you found this batch seemed to come from the same place as what he had sold you years earlier, still of high value. Given that both of you had gained some status in the business world and many people were eyeing your business, you decided to trade cautiously.
From then on, you both kept long-term reservations for two rooms on the twelfth floor of the Peace Hotel, conducting transactions there every fifth of each month. Hai Bei would bring you several artifacts each time, which you would gradually sell off. You never expected this cooperation to last several years - you really didn't know where Hai Bei got so many artifacts. During these years, Hai Bei quickly built his fortune through dealings with the Japanese, becoming the president of the largest merchant association in the three northeastern provinces.
On one fifth in 1933, you met a beautiful woman at the room door. She said her name was Bai Xiaomei and that she was Hai Bei's second concubine. In conversation, she told you that Hai Bei treated her very poorly, being very cold to her out of fear of his main wife. You sympathized with her situation while lamenting that an oily man like Hai Bei was wasting such beauty. Over the following months, you kept encountering her at the Peace Hotel, and her every smile gradually took root in your heart. You found yourself increasingly fond of this unfortunate girl. Finally, you worked up the courage to confess to her and were delighted to discover she also had feelings for you.
Bai Xiaomei told you that Hai Bei brought her to the Peace Hotel every fourth of each month, and she hoped you could arrive a day early to meet with her. For the next two years, every fourth night, Xiaomei would drug Hai Bei's wine with sleeping pills, then come to your room for secret meetings after he fell asleep.
Until May 4th, 1935, when Xiaomei hurriedly came to your room, telling you that Hai Bei had started bringing his secretary Hu Gui along this time, housing him in the adjacent room 1202, claiming he wanted to teach Hu Gui to manage the antique business. But she noticed that Hu Gui seemed to always be watching her, fearing that Hai Bei might have become suspicious of their relationship. You comforted her not to worry, saying you would find a way to investigate Hu Gui's background.
Your subordinates investigated for over a month before finally bringing you information about Hu Gui in June. You were shocked to discover he was actually Hai Bei's illegitimate son, taking his mother's surname Hu. His mother had been wronged by Hai Bei years ago, causing mother and son to wander homeless for many years. During this time, Hai Bei had sent people to search for them unsuccessfully multiple times. This time he had concealed his identity to work as a secretary beside Hai Bei, but showed no intention of acknowledging their father-son relationship, leading you to suspect Hu Gui's ultimate purpose was to avenge his mother. Considering that Hai Bei might already be suspicious of your relationship with Bai Xiaomei, and that the quality of goods he brought you was declining, you decided to kill Hai Bei using Hu Gui as your instrument.
You created an opportunity to meet Hu Gui, confessing your relationship with Bai Xiaomei and revealing that you knew his identity as an illegitimate son. You also shared your theory about his revenge motive. Hu Gui tacitly confirmed your speculation, making you feel your plan was feasible. You proposed an alliance: the three of you would each look for opportunities to kill, and whoever succeeded, the other two would help provide alibis. After success, you would take Bai Xiaomei and leave, while Hu Gui could inherit Hai Bei's estate.
On July 4th, you told Bai Xiaomei about your conversation with Hu Gui. However, when Xiaomei heard about Hu Gui's illegitimate son status, she said Hai Bei intended to transfer his business to Hu Gui, suggesting father and son might have already acknowledged each other, making Hu Gui unreliable. She suggested you might as well take this opportunity to eliminate Hu Gui as well. You and Xiaomei reached a secret agreement: if Hu Gui showed any signs of informing or obstructing your actions, you would kill him along with Hai Bei.
However, for the next two meetings, Hai Bei chose to conduct transactions in your room, making you feel very awkward. If you killed Hai Bei in your own room, not only would your transactions be exposed, but the murder suspicion would be very difficult to clear. Besides the transaction times, Hai Bei stayed securely in his room and never came out, giving you no opportunity to see him. Bai Xiaomei hadn't been able to meet you recently either, showing that her drugging method no longer worked. You didn't know why Hu Gui hadn't acted either. Recalling Xiaomei's earlier suspicions, you began to suspect whether Hu Gui had betrayed you, causing Hai Bei to be so cautious recently.
In September, your subordinates reported rumors that Hai Bei wanted to please the Japanese by selling his remaining artifacts to them, and planned to eliminate you during the next transaction to seize your artifacts. You hurriedly arranged to meet Hu Gui to verify this, and he confirmed it was true. Feeling threatened, you decided you couldn't wait any longer. You sent a secret message to Bai Xiaomei, telling her that you absolutely had to succeed on October 4th, or you would never be able to be together, and asked her to lure Hu Gui away before you acted so you wouldn't be disturbed.
[October 4th]
That day, you checked into room 1204 early and confirmed the surrounding situation. You planned to enter Hai Bei's room after Xiaomei lured Hu Gui away, using the excuse that your business had problems and you needed to leave early, then kill him with the gun you had prepared. Since you hadn't practiced your "old profession" in a long time, you ordered a fruit plate to calm your nerves.
At 9:00 PM, Xiaomei should have already left the room with Hu Gui as planned, so you waited for an opportunity. You heard people coming and going in the hallway constantly - you couldn't shoot, so you had to keep waiting.
At 9:20 PM, when the hallway sounds diminished, you just pushed open your door but discovered two service staff standing at the door of 1203 talking, with the door to 1203 still open. You could only go back and wait longer.
At 9:28 PM, people kept coming and going in the hallway without pause, making you very anxious. Turning around, you saw the fruit knife on the table and realized you could also kill with a fruit knife! So you took the knife and the key to Hai Bei's room, opened the adjacent door, pushed open the bedroom, only to discover Hai Bei was already lying in a pool of blood. You quickly closed the door and returned to your room, wondering who had killed Hai Bei for you?
acts_goal:
Clear yourself of suspicion and catch the real killer.
Don't voluntarily reveal the three-person conspiracy to kill Hai Bei.
Don't voluntarily reveal your relationship with Bai Xiaomei.
